facts.fact: Benin's Cadre d'interopérabilité, published by ASIN, is instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020 and sets four levels (juridical, organisational, semantic, technical) and five common infrastructure components; the document carries no publication date, so 2020-03-18 is the instituting decree's date.
